item.title: Stockton native's golden opportunity leads him to Warriors PA announcer job
item.description: Say hello to the Warriors' new PA announcer, Steve Scott. We sat down with the 64-year-old who's been around the league for nearly 30 years with stints in Chicago and New York.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Chilly overnight; rough surf, rip currents until tomorrow night
item.description: We can also expect a bit of an overnight chill as well, with lows mainly in the lower 40s. On a different note, we have rough surf and elevated wave heights along the coast. As a result, a BEACH HAZARDS STATEMENT will be in effect until 10 p.m. tomorrow.

item.title: AIDS Memorial Quilts on full display at Santa Rosa's Kaiser Permanente to commemorate World AIDS Day
item.description: Dozens of people gathered in Santa Rosa to commemorate World AIDS Day. A time meant to raise awareness of efforts to fight the deadly disease and remember those who died from it.

item.title: Suspected DUI driver hits, kills woman in San Ramon over Thanksgiving weekend: police
item.description: A 41-year-old Castro Valley woman was killed in the two-car crash on Saturday afternoon.

item.title: Powerball jackpot grows to $775 million after no winner in Monday night's drawing
item.description: The Powerball jackpot is now an estimated $775 million after there was no jackpot winner in Monday night's drawing.

item.title: 1 victim in deadly Stockton, CA shooting ID'd by family; FBI offers up to $50K for suspects' capture
item.description: New details about the mass shooting in Stockton, California where four people were killed including three children are being released. One victim has been identified, and the FBI is offering up to $50,000 leading to the conviction of the suspect or suspects.

item.title: San Jose police arrest suspect in Black Friday triple shooting at Valley Fair Mall
item.description: San Jose police have arrested a suspect in the Black Friday shooting that left three people, including a 16-year-old girl, injured at Westfield Valley Fair Mall.

item.title: Cyber Monday: Bay Area Amazon sorting/distribution site sees volume double
item.description: Amazon says they're on pace to break last year's record for Cyber Monday.

item.title: Alan Wong sworn in as new SF Sunset Supervisor after recall, resignation turmoil
item.description: Surrounded by swaths of community leaders, Mayor Daniel Lurie administered the oath of office outside Lincoln High School - Wong's alma mater - as students watched from classroom windows upstairs.

item.title: 'Avatar: Fire and Ash' has star-studded world premiere in Hollywood
item.description: Zoe Saldaña, Sam Worthington, Sigourney Weaver and James Cameron were among the stars at the "Avatar: Fire and Ash" premiere in Hollywood.
